promo_floodfill_enabled.description: Kill switch for the Color Shift cross-promo banner

promo_min_sessions.description: Banner never shows before this app launch number (1 = show from the first launch)

promo_dismiss_snooze_days.description: Days until the banner comes back after the user taps X

promo_max_dismissals.description: While this many X taps fall within promo_dismiss_window_days, the banner stays hidden

promo_dismiss_window_days.description: Rolling window (days) for promo_max_dismissals; the banner returns once the older tap leaves it
